name: AFL-CIO Legislative Scorecard
source: https://aflcio.org/scorecard/legislators (2025 House list pages 0-21; senators from individual pages https://aflcio.org/scorecard/legislators/<first-last>)
notes: Score is the share of 2025 AFL-CIO key votes where the member voted with the AFL-CIO position (published percent). Lifetime is the AFL-CIO lifetime score percent from the same site. House read from the 22 page legislators table (2025 House scorecard), matched to the roster by state, district and last name. The site Senate table is not reachable by URL (chamber toggle is not a query parameter), so each senator was read from an individual member page. Gaps (score and lifetime null): Senate Ashley Moody (FL), Alan Armstrong (OK), Darline Graham (SC) (page not found, likely new or appointed, or slug unknown); House members not in the 2025 list because they took office after it (special elections): Christian Menefee TX-18, Clay Fuller GA-14, Analilia Mejia NJ-11, James Gallagher CA-1, Everton Blair Jr. GA-13, Aisha Wahab CA-14; and the six non-voting delegates (DC, VI, AS, GU, MP, PR) which the scorecard does not list (Norton page not found; Menefee page fetch errored once, not retried). The list also carries members who have left (Cherfilus-McCormick, Gonzales, Connolly, Green, Greene, LaMalfa, Scott, Sherrill, Swalwell, Turner, Waltz) who are not on the current roster and were skipped. The House list parse showed 437 rows from 438 expected, one row (Carol Miller WV-1) was recovered via her member page.
